messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty -> SEV2 billing/metering: downstream aggregator lag detected; delayed emits causing transient overage flags for a subset of customers. alert_id=INC-2026-0042

mike: ack i'm oncall, joining. starting quick blast radius check :mag:

billing-bot: telemetry delta: aggregator vs ledger token counts divergence = 4.2% over last 15m, emit-delay window = ~18m

javier: looking at billing-consumer group `billing-agg-v2` — consumer lag ~1,825,314 messages, last committed offset ~125,410,900 (04:12 UTC)
emily: kafka broker eu3 under higher IO, partition 5 lagging. output from `kafka-consumer-groups --describe --group billing-agg-v2` pasted: partition 5 leader=broker-3 lag=1,120,402

mike: we need to stop sending auto overage emails ASAP. who can flip suppression for alerts/notifications? :rotating_light:

sara: support seeing 2 tickets from customers about overage emails in last 10m, triage started, adding sample IDs

ashley: product ok to suppress for now to avoid churn. mike, do the suppression and post the CS template here.

mike: ran `curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/suppress?scope=overage_alerts&window=2h` -> 200 OK. Posting CS template in #support-docs.

javier: initiating consumer restart on billing-agg-3 and increasing concurrency from 3->6. will monitor rebalance.
emily: starting a controlled replay/backfill from raw-usage topic for the stuck partitions. command: `./kafka_replay --topic raw-usage --from-offset 125000000 --to-latest --group replay-debug --throttle 250` ETA ~45m at 250 msg/s

billing-bot: quick estimate: ~12k customers may see delayed marks; false-positive overage flags expected ~3% of active accounts — recommend blocking outbound billing-notify emails until reconciliation

mike: task list: javier -> consumer restart & partition rebalance, emily -> backfill + monitor throughput, ashley -> draft CS note, sara -> monitor inbound tickets and update thread. i'll coordinate and update page.

javier: consumer restart completed, consumer rejoined; rebalance in progress. still seeing a stuck offset on partition 5, moving leader to broker-1 now.
emily: replay started; throttled at 250 msg/s. progress: replayed ~420k msgs in 30m, remaining ~1.4M, ETA now ~35m after rebound

mike: i've paused the billing alert rule in Sentry and muted automated billing-email webhook for 2h window. note in audit: `suppress overage_alerts (2h) by mike`

sara: updated support doc with sample emails + suggested reply template: "We're investigating a temporary billing notification issue; your usage will be reconciled and any incorrect charges/refunds will be applied."

ashley: merged PR to stop auto billing emails from webhook-trigger pipeline, will deploy now (small config toggle).

javier: rebalance completed, partition 5 leader moved, consumer lag now 85,193 and trending down. consumer throughput ~1.1k msgs/s after concurrency bump
emily: backfill finished for the window, started reconciliation run: `python tools/reconcile_usage.py --window 2026-04-21T03:50Z..2026-04-21T04:20Z --sample 1000` — sample reconciles look good, token delta reduced to 0.1%
billing-bot: post-reconcile metrics: ledger vs aggregator delta = 0.09%, overage-flag rate back to baseline
mike: good progress. unsuppressing alerts only after reconciliation complete and delta <0.2%. set reminder to unsuppress at 1729346800 if metrics stable.

ashley: draft CS message posted to #support-docs, sara approved. will send targeted batch update once reconciliation job finishes.
sara: I'll monitor tickets and escalate any customers who already paid. created shared spreadsheet link in thread.

incident-bot: incident status: active -> mitigated (primary backlog drained). severity=S2, incident_channel=#inc-1729345678, runbook=internal/mitigations/billing-lag

mike: keeping this thread open until we confirm no downstream replays fail. handoff: i'll be on until lag <100k and reconciliation job finished. after that we'll run a short RCA and postmortem template. thanks team. :white_check_mark:

javier: final check: consumer group stable, latest lag <12k across partitions.
emily: reconciliation completed, sample audit shows no customer-facing charge changes needed besides automated reversal for 2 accounts flagged earlier.

mike: unsuppressing notifications now and re-enabling billing alerting. will follow up with postmortem link in 24h. great job everyone!
